StackOne published a blog post on June 22, 2026 titled 'Closing the Loop: A Self-Evolving Defense' at https://www.stackone.com/blog/closing-the-loop-self-evolving-defense/. The post describes Adaptive Defender, a system that runs on a weekly schedule to discover new attack techniques across Hugging Face, arXiv, and GitHub; scores them against frontier models and the shipped Defender classifier; proposes corpus updates; retrains the classifier; and files a pull request on the Defender repository.
